mathematical_change.claim: Sharp law-uniform Fourier Lq threshold on the admissible extreme class
mathematical_change.statement: For q>=2, sup_{0<=f<=1,int f=1} ||hat f||_q <= (2 pi)^(1/q). For every 1<q<2, the supremum is infinite even over bounded finite unions of intervals of total measure one.
mathematical_change.implication: The existing factorwise geometric Brascamp-Lieb/Fourier route with q_i=1/c_i cannot cross row leverage c_i=1/2 by unchanged one-factor estimates.
